name: How long does a typical sliding door lock repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sliding door lock repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sliding door lock repair can vary depending on the complexity of the issue. Simple repairs, such as adjusting alignment or cleaning the mechanism, might take less than an hour. More involved repairs, like replacing specific internal parts or addressing significant damage, could take 1-3 hours. If a full lock replacement is necessary, the process generally takes about 1-2 hours, assuming the new lock is readily available and compatible with your door. We strive for efficient service to minimize disruption to your day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple sliding door lock repairs can take under an hour, while more complex repairs or replacements typically range from 1 to 3 hours.
